evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Charles Lovering and Ellie Pavlick
evidence_items.explanation: The study links training frequencies to failures on reversed relationships in Stable Diffusion 2.1. This is relevant evidence for the proposed explanation, but it concerns an earlier, narrower model study and does not isolate lack of understanding as the cause.

The study reports that selecting suitable generation seeds using reference images improves rare-concept generation without retraining. This complicates an inference from failed outputs to absent conceptual capacity, while remaining compatible with training imbalance contributing to default failures.

unresolved_gaps: No located study establishes the full causal explanation across the contemporary systems and tasks covered by the claim.
Observed relationships between frequency and performance do not separate all competing causes.
There is no agreed measurement of deep understanding in the claim.
The cited experiments predate the target period and are retained as context.
